# Polygon Gaming (PGT) - Complete AI Knowledge Base

> Polygon Gaming (https://polygongaming.io/) is an all-in-one Web3 Play-to-Earn gaming ecosystem on Polygon.

## 1. Tokenomics & Smart Contracts
- **Token Name**: Polygon Gaming Token (PGT)
- **Token Symbol**: PGT
- **Polygon Contract Address**: `0x701100D19b1a93672cfe7291EA455b4220631209`
- **PolyGame NFT Contract**: `0x45D80Ea3a24978350ccC6A61A2d89B031435eCB8`
- **Total Max Supply**: 1,000,000,000 PGT (1 Billion)
  - 70% (700M) - Players & Play-to-Earn Rewards
  - 10% (100M) - Publicity & Ecosystem Growth
  - 10% (100M) - Developer Treasury
  - 10% (100M) - Liquidity Pools

## 2. Gameplay Features
- **Astro-Dodge Arcade**: 60 FPS neon arcade dodging game. Convert high scores to PGT.
- **Cyber Invaders**: Space shooter arcade game with weekly leaderboard payouts.
- **Cyber Drift**: Neon racing drift game earning PGT rewards.
- **PolySpace Mining Operations**: Fleet exploration simulator where players launch starships, upgrade plasma drills, and harvest PGT, Iron, Titanium, and Quantum Crystals.
- **Crypto Faucet**: Hourly faucet payout for instant free tokens. VIP Supporter Subscription grants 2x rewards and 10% faster 21.6-hour cooldowns.
- **Staking Vault**: Deposit PGT into APY pools for passive yield accumulation.
- **NFT Marketplace**: Purchase Utility NFTs for permanent passive payout multipliers across faucet, arcade, and referrals.
- **4-Tier Referral System**: Earn 10% (L1), 5% (L2), 2% (L3), 1% (L4) on downline earnings. VIP doubles rates to 20% / 10% / 4% / 2%.
